lane: Phase 2 backend: record the 2026-10-26 read-only Singapore readback and prepare the step 2 Owner approval form
goal: Record the read-only state of Supabase project etfajmrwyywokgafzxsb read on 2026-10-26 in packet A, and add an Owner approval form for step 2 (SQL packet) that asks one decision at a time, without running any SQL write, migration, function deployment or settings change.
successCriteria: Packet A states the 2026-10-26 readback values (Postgres version, 0 public tables, 0 migrations, 0 Edge Functions, 0 buckets, 0 Auth users, roles, extensions) and that they match earlier verifications.
Risks R1 and R2 in packet A are updated with the read-only evidence; risk R3 stays open.

The approval form names exactly one decision for now (packet content and target), with object, hashes, risk, stop conditions and rollback, and lists the later separate decisions without approving them.
The README and the handoff document no longer say step 1 is pending or that the packet is still in an open PR.
No secret, token, password or key value appears in any changed file.
The Owner's 2026-10-26 approval of decision 2a is recorded verbatim in the approval form with the full hashes, the commit they were rechecked at, its scope and when it expires.
untouchedSurfaces: Migration files, seed, packet-manifest.json and replay-receipt.json are not edited, so the approved hashes stay unchanged.
docs/release/release-profile.json targets stay empty and the legacy migration ledger stays blocked_pending_reconciliation.
No application, Admin, Edge Function, workflow or configuration file is changed.
No cloud setting, secret or credential is read or changed; the Singapore project received read-only queries only.
